'''Koya Utrila''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] servant to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. She was the triplet of [[Dai Utrila]] and [[Rihn Utrila]].
